q1_issues.issue: (Future sk_arrive_1) is not licensed: the futurate rule requires either a calendar time placeable after a supplied TODAY or a lexically future adjunct, and "at noon" with no CONTEXT/TODAY is the unanchored-adjunct case ("the survey begins at dawn"), which must carry no tense atom at all.

q2_gaps: named clock time "noon": it is not in the deictic-constant list, not in the day-part list (morning/afternoon/evening/night), and not a numeral clock expression, so whether it becomes a structured (Hour 12) term or a bare symbol is unspecified
notes: Agent for the intransitive "arrive" subject follows the instruction set's explicit motion-verb list, and the definite mass subject correctly gets a typed witness; only the tense atom is a defect.
